evals.prompt: I want a warm, dreamy piano loop with lots of reverb in a minor key. Something perfect for a chill lo-fi beat.
evals.expected_output: Prompt should contain: Keys/Grand Piano, Warm, Airy/Silky, High Reverb, Chord Progression or Melody, 8 Bars, a minor key, 100-115 BPM range

assertions.text: Contains a piano instrument (Keys or Grand Piano)
Contains at least 2 timbre tags (Warm, Airy, Silky, etc.)
Contains reverb tag (Medium Reverb or High Reverb)
Contains musical movement (Chord Progression, Melody, or Legato)
Contains a minor key (C minor, D# minor, Eb minor, etc.)

evals.prompt: Generate three variations of a synth bass sound: one aggressive and distorted, one smooth and warm, one with phaser effect. All should be suitable for electronic music around 128 BPM.
evals.expected_output: Three distinct prompts, each with Synth/Bass, appropriate timbre tags, FX, 8 Bars, 128 BPM, and a minor key

assertions.text: Each prompt contains Bass or Synth
Contains Distortion or Overdrive tag (aggressive variation)
Contains Warm or Smooth tag (warm variation)

evals.prompt: I need a guitar loop for my electronic track. Something moody and atmospheric, maybe with some delay and reverb. The tempo is around 120 BPM.
evals.expected_output: Prompt should contain: Guitar, atmospheric/dark moody descriptors, delay tag, reverb tag, ~120 BPM, suitable bar count

assertions.text: Contains mood descriptor (Dark, Moody, Atmospheric, or similar)
Contains a delay tag (Medium Delay, Low Delay, or High Delay)
